newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks up on interest rate expectations.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks up on interest rate expectations.

text.p: Colombian stocks rose Tuesday on the back of expectations of a further drop in interest rates, dealers said.

Bogota IBB .IBB index climbed 1.44 percent to 1,348.71 amid a 2.3 billion peso volume while Medellin's IBOMED .IBMG general price index gained 0.81 percent to 20,007.66 amid a 2.4 billion peso volume.
"Unquestionably the central bank is giving signs that it will cut interest rates further," one broker said.
The central bank cut its overnight deposit rates by 0.5 percent to 20 percent. Overnight lending rates now stand at 27 percent.
One of the day's biggest gainers was brewing giant Bavaria up 3.38 percent to 10,700 in Bogota and up 2.88 percent to the same price in Medellin.
Gas distribution company Promigas gained 0.55 percent to close at 7,200 in Bogota.
In Medellin cement manufacturer Cementos Paz del Rio gained 1.54 percent to 1,249.
